_about: Languages and translated pages. Each language page lives in its own folder (/id/referral-program) and reads its copy from content/pages/<page>/<lang>.json, falling back to en.json for anything missing. To translate a page: add its <lang>.json, then list the language under 'pages' below. build-i18n.py, build-seo.py and scripts/build.mjs all read this file.
